# ingress-job

> Public job board for open roles in Azerbaijan. Browse listings, search by title or company, filter by city and language. Locales: az (default), en, ru.

## One-line entity

ingress-job is a multilingual job listings site for Azerbaijan: public browse of open roles, employer posting after sign-in, and candidate applications. Private cabinets (post, company, applications, profile, admin) are not for indexing.

## Key pages

- Home (az): /
- Home (en): /en
- Home (ru): /ru
- Job detail pattern: /jobs/{id} · /en/jobs/{id} · /ru/jobs/{id}
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- Robots: /robots.txt

## What to index

- Public home pages in az / en / ru
- Public job detail pages with JobPosting structured data
- Do not treat /api/, /admin, /applications, /profile, /notifications, /company, /post (and locale-prefixed twins) as content pages

## Product notes

- Listings may be onsite (employer-posted) or aggregated from sources
- Apply / original links may require an authenticated session
- Currency and market context: Azerbaijan (AZ); salaries often in AZN when shown
